findings.effect: rtt_supported_bool (CarrierConfigManager.java:3418, default false at :12190). With true and ignore_rtt_mode_setting_bool at its default true (:11996), ImsManager.updateRttConfigValue provisions RTT on and keeps IMS turned on even when nothing else needs it (ImsManager.java:2756-2797, 1763-1785). ImsRegistrationTracker then adds TEXT beside each VOICE capability, using rtt_supported_while_roaming_bool when roaming (ImsRegistrationTracker.java:419-424, 585-598). AosHandleEmergencyMtc adds TEXT to the emergency registration whenever the key is true, with no roaming or network check (AosHandleEmergencyMtc.cpp:45-63). AosCondition.IsDeregRequiredForTty deregisters in TTY mode only when RTT is off, VoLTE TTY is off and the phone is combined-attached (AosCondition.cpp:998-1031). AosRegistration.UpdateNetworkFeatureRtt marks TEXT unavailable on a normal registration the network does not confirm (AosRegistration.cpp:1210-1245). A call type is cut down to the registered features (CallTypeUtil.cpp:24-66), and a voice call stays audio only (MtcMediaUtil.cpp:74-92, IdleState.cpp:550-552). Emergency TTY routing reads carrier_volte_tty_supported_bool, not this key (EmergencyCallDomainSelector.java:755-756, 1168-1169, 2045-2057). Telephony's own gate needs R.bool.config_support_rtt, which is false on 23.2 and on lineage-24.0 (config.xml:235, no overlay in the x1s device trees), so isRttSupported and isRttEnabled are false and the PhoneAccount has no RTT capability (PhoneInterfaceManager.java:7995-8035, TelecomAccountRegistry.java:1128-1154). Telecom still creates RTT streams for an emergency call when the calling app asks for RTT (CallsManager.java:2650-2662). ImsManager.java at android-17.0.0_r1 equals the tree. On a phone: admitted only for the most specific profile that sets the key, else the Google-lane value, else Android's default false (Serving.kt:405-440).
